name: giant_tarantula
description: South American giant tarantula (Theraphosa blondi, the largest living spider), top-down, head to the right: same style as megarachne_spider_1980 but lighter brown-pink (#8a6650) with pale pinkish hairs and leg bands, round abdomen, eight thick hairy legs, small fangs. Anchor centre. ~590x560 (x -300..300, y -280..280); drawn at 0.42 beside the 1980 spider at 0.7.
